theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only high-durability, eligible leader with strong breadth (0.833) and a trend hurst tag, and the one-narrative structure suggests participation is concentrated rather than broad. The lean is a continuation-of-focus call, not a return forecast: keep exposure to the dominant theme absent a confirmed handoff. Crowding (z=1.82) is a size-down caution only, never a fade.
theses.dissent: Gate_helps is false on this market — the trend discipline did not cut drawdown here, and dir_accuracy (0.373) suggests direction calls historically underperform coin-flip. Crowding near 2 sigma often marks late-stage attention concentration; the theme could reverse without any rotation handoff signal.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS trails the CSI 300 by 4% or more over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Eligible but score near zero (0.16), crowded (z=1.35), mixed hurst, and weak breadth (0.429). It holds a slot in the narrow eligible set (2 of 22) but shows none of the coherence of the leader. In a one-narrative regime, holding the lagging eligible name offers poor risk-adjusted focus. Avoid expresses a relative-preference call, not a short.
theses.dissent: As one of only two eligible themes, it is the only scorable alternative if Banks stalls; mixed hurst could mean early stabilization, and its proxy (159992.SZ) is liquid enough to catch a handoff.
